notes: The in-app Backtest button for Breakout Trendline now models the same stop-loss and take-profit logic the live bot actually uses (swing/ATR-based stop, dynamic support-resistance target), instead of a simplified flat-pips model that made results look far worse than real trading. Also, the Trading Mode selector (More trades / Balanced / Fewer, safer) now actually changes how the bot trades: More trades takes every valid breakout, Balanced only trades with the higher-timeframe trend, and Fewer, safer additionally requires the H4 trend to agree before entering. Previously this selector had no effect on the Breakout Trendline strategy.
